text:
amanda: Heads-up — large EU POC stuck. Customer pinned model `redwood-v2-7b` in eu-west-1 and gets `model_not_available` on generation. POC kickoff is tomorrow, can Eng triage?

 diego: Which API call / SDK? can you paste the exact error payload and whether they have fallback enabled?

 amanda: They used our JS SDK with a `model` pin in the request. Error from their logs:
 ```json
{"error":"model_not_available","message":"Model redwood-v2-7b not available in region eu-west-1 for this account"}
```
 Also they reported intermittent 429s when retrying attempts.

 priya: Are they on Hosted or Dedicated trial for the POC? fallback policy toggled off?

 amanda: Dedicated trial (dedicated-beta). They explicitly disabled fallback to force pin validation. Account ID: acct-98231. More log context:
 ```log
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z ERROR node-selector: no eligible pool for model redwood-v2-7b in eu-west-1 org=acct-98231
2026-03-15T10:12:04Z WARN retry: rate limited (429)
```

 diego: Likely cause: quantized artifact (or compatible variant) for `redwood-v2-7b` isn't present in eu-west-1 dedicated pools for that org. Two paths: 1) Immediate workaround: allow fallback or re-pin to `redwood-v2-7b-fp16` (available) 2) Medium-term: replicate the quant artifact to eu-west-1 for the org (infra work, ~24–48h). Which do we want to propose to customer?

 ben: I checked infra capacity — we currently have no 7b-quant images in eu-west-1 for dedicated pools scoped to that org. We can push artifacts but need infra window and quota, ETA ~48h.

 amanda: Customer asked about cost/perf delta between fp16 and quant — they want latency <120ms/token if possible and lower cost for POC. Any quick numbers?

 diego: Quick guidance: fp16 is baseline latency (1.0x). 4-bit quant reduces memory and can cut token cost ~30–40% for 7b, but at very low QPS you might see +5–10% tail latency due to extra dequant/packing. For batchy workloads quant is win; for single short-turn interactive loads, fp16 often has slightly better p99. Rough estimate: fp16 ~ $0.065 / 1k tokens, quant ~ $0.042 / 1k tokens. (give ranges to customer).

 priya: Proposed triage steps for this thread: 1) Ask account to temporarily enable fallback to `redwood-v2-7b-fp16` (fast). 2) Ben/Infra to open replication ticket to backfill quant artifact to eu-west-1 (48h ETA). 3) We'll provide pricing delta and perf notes for the POC contract. I'll send a short checklist to the customer.

 support-bot: Ticket created: INC-98123 — infra replication requested for `redwood-v2-7b-quant` to eu-west-1 for acct-98231. ETA 48h.

 amanda: :thumbsup: Customer ok with temporary fallback to fp16. I'll send them the snippet to enable fallback and the pricing estimates for 2M tokens/month. Also confirming they accept the 48h backfill plan.

 ben: Assigning to infra lead + infra-oncall, will update INC-98123 with artifact push schedule and quota confirmation.

 priya: Config snippet for Dedicated POC to allow fallback (can paste to them):
 ```json
{"model_pin":"redwood-v2-7b","allow_fallback":true,"fallback_order":["redwood-v2-7b-fp16","redwood-v2-7b-quant"]}
```

 amanda: Perfect — I'll loop back once customer confirms. Thanks for the quick help :raised_hands:

 diego: If they need strict pinning and we can't replicate in time, we can also propose switching region (eu-central) if that pool already has the artifact. Let me know if customer refuses fallback.

 amanda: Noted. For now fallback accepted. Closing loop on our side; will reopen if anything changes.
